key_findings: Chemogenetic inhibition of insular cortex GABAergic neurons or KOR agonism (U50488) in the IC blocked relapse of pain-related aversive memory after crossover carrageenan injections; activation of IC GABAergic neurons or KOR antagonism (norBNI) induced it.
Electroacupuncture (ST36/SP6) blocked aversive memory relapse, an effect reversed by IC KOR inhibition or IC GABAergic neuron activation.
